query: We speculate that immature feedback to ACx may underlie these differences for several reasons. First, feedback from higher cortical regions to more primary cortices has been proposed as a neural substrate for difficult perceptual discriminations (Ahissar and Hochstein, 2004; Ahissar and Hochstein, 1997). Second, feedback activity (often referred to as 'top down') is thought to be the key neural pathway involved in cognitive control mechanisms (Zagha, 2020). Feedback is typically expressed in the late (>100 ms) phase of single neurons activity, which was significantly different between adults and adolescents across our measured parameters (onset-latency, duration of discriminability, and maximal discriminability; Figure 4g, Table 2, Table 3).
